script_text: Stop right now, Aries — your ruling planet Mars is about to rewrite your entire destiny! The Moon in Virgo is opposing your chart ruler Mars in your 7th House of Partnership, creating electric tension that demands immediate action. If you're coupled, expect an intense emotional conversation that could either deepen your bond or expose cracks — honesty will be your only path forward. Solo Aries, this opposition sharpens your magnetism; someone watching from the shadows may finally make their move. Money flows through sudden insights today — a Jupiter sextile to your 2nd House ruler reveals an unexpected windfall or investment opportunity you must claim by noon. Avoid impulsive spending or heated words with authority figures; Mercury retrograde in your 10th House warns that digital communication with bosses could be misunderstood. Your hidden strength emerges when you surrender control — let the cosmos guide your hand. Follow for tomorrow's shocking revelation!
